description: Browse the Open Brewery DB directory of 8,000+ breweries, cideries, and brewpubs. Filter by city, state, country, postal code, brewery type, distance from a coordinate, or specific IDs. Returns name, address, geo-coordinates, phone, and website for each match (Open Brewery DB, MIT-licensed open dataset)

by_country.description: Filter breweries by country name (e.g. "United States").

by_dist.description: Sort results by distance from an origin point, as "latitude,longitude" (e.g. "39.7,-104.9"). Cannot be combined with sort.

by_ids.description: Comma-separated list of specific brewery IDs to fetch.

by_postal.description: Filter by postal/ZIP code — 5-digit or postal+4 (e.g. "44107" or "44107-1234").

by_state.description: Filter by full state/province name, no abbreviations (e.g. "California").

sort.description: Sort field(s) with asc/desc, e.g. "name" or "name:desc". Not usable with by_dist.

name: openbrewery.breweries.list

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: List/Filter Breweries
